# Notes.ThatVetGuy

> Free academic resources, thoughtfully made for future vets.

A free academic directory primarily for BVSc & AH students. Original summaries: Dr. Chirag Patidar, BVSc & AH, MVSc. Files are indexed from the supplied Google Drive folders. Known source credits are preserved; inclusion does not imply authorship or medical review.

Main website: https://thatvetguy.net
Author: Dr. Chirag Patidar
Last source review: 2026-10-14; source file metadata was inspected from the supplied public folders; access settings can change.

## Questions, answered

Where do these files open?

Files open in the supplied Google Drive collection. Availability and access settings are controlled by the file owner.

Why is Download missing on some files?

A direct Download action is shown only when a binary file has a known size below 25 MB. Larger files and files with unknown sizes use the Drive viewer.

## Questions, answered

Where do these files open?

Files open in the supplied Google Drive collection. Availability and access settings are controlled by the file owner.

Why is Download missing on some files?

A direct Download action is shown only when a binary file has a known size below 25 MB. Larger files and files with unknown sizes use the Drive viewer.

## Questions, answered

Where do these files open?

Files open in the supplied Google Drive collection. Availability and access settings are controlled by the file owner.

Why is Download missing on some files?

A direct Download action is shown only when a binary file has a known size below 25 MB. Larger files and files with unknown sizes use the Drive viewer.

## Questions, answered

Where do these files open?

Files open in the supplied Google Drive collection. Availability and access settings are controlled by the file owner.

Why is Download missing on some files?

A direct Download action is shown only when a binary file has a known size below 25 MB. Larger files and files with unknown sizes use the Drive viewer.

## Questions, answered

Where do these files open?

Files open in the supplied Google Drive collection. Availability and access settings are controlled by the file owner.

Why is Download missing on some files?

A direct Download action is shown only when a binary file has a known size below 25 MB. Larger files and files with unknown sizes use the Drive viewer.

## Questions, answered

Where do these files open?

Files open in the supplied Google Drive collection. Availability and access settings are controlled by the file owner.

Why is Download missing on some files?

A direct Download action is shown only when a binary file has a known size below 25 MB. Larger files and files with unknown sizes use the Drive viewer.

## Questions, answered

Where do these files open?

Files open in the supplied Google Drive collection. Availability and access settings are controlled by the file owner.

Why is Download missing on some files?

A direct Download action is shown only when a binary file has a known size below 25 MB. Larger files and files with unknown sizes use the Drive viewer.

Last checked: 2026-10-14. This date records source review, not a guarantee of external file availability.

## Questions, answered

Where do these files open?

Files open in the supplied Google Drive collection. Availability and access settings are controlled by the file owner.

Why is Download missing on some files?

A direct Download action is shown only when a binary file has a known size below 25 MB. Larger files and files with unknown sizes use the Drive viewer.

Last checked: 2026-10-14. This date records source review, not a guarantee of external file availability.

## Questions, answered

Where do these files open?

Files open in the supplied Google Drive collection. Availability and access settings are controlled by the file owner.

Why is Download missing on some files?

A direct Download action is shown only when a binary file has a known size below 25 MB. Larger files and files with unknown sizes use the Drive viewer.

## Questions, answered

Where do these files open?

Files open in the supplied Google Drive collection. Availability and access settings are controlled by the file owner.

Why is Download missing on some files?

A direct Download action is shown only when a binary file has a known size below 25 MB. Larger files and files with unknown sizes use the Drive viewer.

## Questions, answered

Where do these files open?

Files open in the supplied Google Drive collection. Availability and access settings are controlled by the file owner.

Why is Download missing on some files?

A direct Download action is shown only when a binary file has a known size below 25 MB. Larger files and files with unknown sizes use the Drive viewer.

## Questions, answered

Where do these files open?

Files open in the supplied Google Drive collection. Availability and access settings are controlled by the file owner.

Why is Download missing on some files?

A direct Download action is shown only when a binary file has a known size below 25 MB. Larger files and files with unknown sizes use the Drive viewer.

## Questions, answered

Where do these files open?

Files open in the supplied Google Drive collection. Availability and access settings are controlled by the file owner.

Why is Download missing on some files?

A direct Download action is shown only when a binary file has a known size below 25 MB. Larger files and files with unknown sizes use the Drive viewer.

## Questions, answered

Where do these files open?

Files open in the supplied Google Drive collection. Availability and access settings are controlled by the file owner.

Why is Download missing on some files?

A direct Download action is shown only when a binary file has a known size below 25 MB. Larger files and files with unknown sizes use the Drive viewer.

## Questions, answered

Where do these files open?

Files open in the supplied Google Drive collection. Availability and access settings are controlled by the file owner.

Why is Download missing on some files?

A direct Download action is shown only when a binary file has a known size below 25 MB. Larger files and files with unknown sizes use the Drive viewer.

## Questions, answered

Where do these files open?

Files open in the supplied Google Drive collection. Availability and access settings are controlled by the file owner.

Why is Download missing on some files?

A direct Download action is shown only when a binary file has a known size below 25 MB. Larger files and files with unknown sizes use the Drive viewer.

## Questions, answered

Where do these files open?

Files open in the supplied Google Drive collection. Availability and access settings are controlled by the file owner.

Why is Download missing on some files?

A direct Download action is shown only when a binary file has a known size below 25 MB. Larger files and files with unknown sizes use the Drive viewer.

## Questions, answered

Where do these files open?

Files open in the supplied Google Drive collection. Availability and access settings are controlled by the file owner.

Why is Download missing on some files?

A direct Download action is shown only when a binary file has a known size below 25 MB. Larger files and files with unknown sizes use the Drive viewer.

# Veterinary Anatomy

Veterinary Anatomy focuses on relating structure to function across domestic animal species. This guide helps BVSc & AH students locate credited notes and year-wise book collections, with a short revision outline to organise reading. Use labelled diagrams to compare the same structure between species, then explain its functional significance.

## Revision topic outline

Use this overview alongside your university syllabus.

- Osteology and arthrology
- Myology and visceral anatomy
- Neuroanatomy and sense organs
- Histology and embryology

Use labelled diagrams to compare the same structure between species, then explain its functional significance.

# Tips & Tools for Vet Study

Explore practical AI study guidance, useful free apps and everyday study tools for veterinary students. Use the guides to organise reading, references and presentations while checking veterinary information against trusted sources.

[Use of AI for Vet Study](https://notes.thatvetguy.net/study-tools/#ai-guide)[Useful Free Apps](https://notes.thatvetguy.net/study-tools/#free-apps)[Useful Study Tools](https://notes.thatvetguy.net/study-tools/#useful-tools)

## Use of AI for Vet Study

AI can help with the notes. You still have to read them.

- 

### Start with your own outline

Ask AI to organise your topic list or suggest a revision structure. Compare the result with your syllabus and original notes.

- 

### Check before you learn

Verify veterinary facts, citations and drug information. A fluent answer can still be wrong; do not use AI output as a prescribing reference.

- 

### Turn reading into an explanation

Draft a presentation outline or ask for simpler wording, then rewrite it in your own words and credit your sources.

## Useful Free Apps

Free apps, because a vet student's budget is already on a drip.

- 

### Zotero

Keep reading references together and check every generated citation against the source.

- 

### LibreOffice

Prepare notes, tables and presentations without a subscription. Keep editable copies as well as PDFs.

- 

### A PDF reader

Use bookmarks and text search in a reader you already have. Keep a small, clearly named offline folder for essential material.

## Useful Study Tools

- 

### Your phone’s document scanner

Scan only material you have permission to copy. Check legibility and file size before sharing it.

- 

### A simple folder system

Use Year / Subject / Notes or Books, then meaningful file names. Search works better when files have useful titles.

- 

### A reference checklist

Record the author, edition, species and date when they matter. A saved file is a starting point, not a substitute for checking context.

## Questions, answered

Can I use AI as a clinical reference?

Use AI to help organise study. Check facts, citations and drug information against original professional references before relying on them.

Do these guides require subscriptions?

The guides describe study habits and tools by name. They do not require signing up or following external software links.

Last checked: 2026-10-14. This date records source review, not a guarantee of external file availability.

# About Notes.ThatVetGuy

Notes.ThatVetGuy is a free academic library for BVSc & AH students, organised around the supplied Google Drive collections. Original revision outlines and on-site study guides help you choose what to read next.

## A useful place to start

The library organises the supplied Google Drive files by professional year, subject and original folder group. File titles, sizes and dates come from the inspected source; known source credits are preserved.

## Original study guidance

Revision outlines and on-site study guides are written for veterinary students. Linked files retain their original authorship; inclusion is not a claim of medical review or ownership.

## Help improve the library

Request a resource or report an error or takedown through the request page.

[Request or report a resource](https://notes.thatvetguy.net/request-resource/)

## Questions, answered

Who writes the original guides?

Original site guides and summaries are by Dr. Chirag Patidar, BVSc & AH, MVSc. External notes, books and references retain their source credit.

Last checked: 2026-10-14. This date records source review, not a guarantee of external file availability.

# Can’t find what you need?

Request a veterinary note, book, PYQ or useful study resource, or report a link that needs attention. Include the subject, year and source so the library can be improved for other veterinary students.

## Tell us what would help

Include the title or topic, subject, year and edition if relevant.

File ID, if reporting a file

[Email your request](mailto:contact@thatvetguy.net?subject=Resource%20request)

You can also write directly to contact@thatvetguy.net. If your email app does not open, copy the address into your preferred email service.

## Contact

Send your question to contact@thatvetguy.net.

## Contribute a resource

Send the original title, subject and source credit. Share only material you have permission to contribute.

## Report an error / takedown

Include the file ID or page URL, the issue and your preferred contact details. For a takedown request, explain your connection to the material so it can be reviewed.

## Questions, answered

How do I report a broken link?

Email contact@thatvetguy.net with the page URL and resource name. The visible email address can be copied if your email application does not open.

Can I contribute a resource?

Send the original source, title and subject to contact@thatvetguy.net. Share material you have permission to contribute.
